subject: Future Tech
title: Nano-Enhanced Batteries
description: A 1-minute de-risking session on Nano-Enhanced Batteries.

hook.text: Your phone battery uses nano-structured electrodes.

buildup.text: Nano-sized electrode particles charge faster because ions travel shorter distances.

discovery.text: Silicon nanowires could replace graphite anodes, storing 10 times more energy.

twist.text: Nanostructured silicon—porous, hollow, or wrapped in carbon shells—prevents cracking.

climax.text: Nano-coatings on solid-state battery electrolytes could enable safe, energy-dense batteries that don't catch fire.

punchline.text: Better batteries start at the nanoscale. Bigger energy, smaller particles.

quiz.question: Why are nano-sized electrode particles better for batteries?
options: Ions travel shorter distances, enabling faster charging
